data.name: Feheema
data.gender_notes: Feheema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fehima', meaning 'comprehension' or 'understanding'. It is a name given to a girl who is mature, wise, and has a deep understanding of life and spiritual matters. The name Feheema carries the meaning “Mature, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Feheema usually hope their child will grow to embody mature, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Feheema belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mature, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Feheema total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
